description: This file contains build rules and definitions related to Chromium OS images and specific device configurations, including kernel packaging, image creation steps, and device-specific parameters for Google's WiFi device based on Qualcomm IPQ4019.

methods.name: Build/cros-gpt
methods.description: Build rule that copies the target file to a temporary location, runs 'ptgen' to generate partition data, appends it to the target file, and cleans up temporary files.

methods.name: Build/append-kernel-part
methods.description: Build rule that appends the kernel image to the target output using 'dd' with specified block size.

methods.name: Build/cros-vboot
methods.description: Build step that invokes 'cros-vbutil' to sign the kernel with Chromium OS-specific parameters, replacing the UUID placeholder with 'PARTUUID=%U'.

methods.name: Device/google_wifi
methods.description: Defines device-specific build parameters for Google's WiFi device, including vendor, model, SOC, kernel configuration, images, and device packages.
